question.text: The MINIMUM net worth requirement for a Portfolio Manager under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020 is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the net worth requirement for a portfolio manager is Rupees five crore. This is the threshold an applicant must meet to be registered and operate as a portfolio manager under the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020. The Trap: Rs. 1 crore and Rs. 2 crore are below the prescribed Rs. 5 crore net worth and do not satisfy the regulation. Rs. 10 crore is higher than what the workbook requires for the portfolio manager net worth. Note: The required figure to remember is Rs. 5 crore net worth as stated in the workbook.
